[[Gerahlad Mahkfahlan]] is a Kournan noble who resides in the vicinity of the [[Mahnkelon Waterworks]].

==Locations==
*[[Kourna]]
**{{NPC location|The Floodplain of Mahnkelon}} (inside the waterworks)

==Dialogue==
:''"Think about what this war will do to trade. We will be cut off from all of our normal shipping lanes. The [[corsair]]s will be the only ones to profit from this."''

==Quotes==
:''"We need to be reasonable and consider the consequences of our decisions before committing to a war with [[Istan]]."''
